title: Lightly Frozen Argentinian Prawns Ceviche
description: A refreshing and herbal Argentinian dish featuring raw frozen prawns, this ceviche is perfect for a light lunch or dinner, and is paleo-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the thawed prawns, chopped parsley, and chopped dill.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, lemon juice, and grapefruit juice.
Pour the juice mixture over the prawn mixture and toss to coat.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the crushed ice and water to create a light and aerated texture.
Serve the ceviche immediately, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
Use a kitchen torch to add a smoky flavor to the dish, if desired.
Garnish with edible flowers or microgreens for a show-stopping presentation.
